scope: twenty-seventh batch: the migrated general-ledger parsing of the income reconciliation family, with its controlled admission entry

live_source.runtime_projection_compare_with_previous: push_runtime_identity_changed (endpoint configuration_digest bbb0fe7e -> 1ed03962; 60 endpoints and both platform flags unchanged)
live_source.runtime_projection_note: the endpoint digest moves on every read-only capture because the running legacy agent keeps writing that table; it is not a migration signal, and this batch writes nothing to the legacy database

checks.reader_doubles: the pinned functions call openpyxl.load_workbook and pdfplumber.open; both are replaced by in-memory doubles that hand over the same cell rows, page text and tables, because reading a file is not part of this migration

checks.note: the migrated decision core is untouched by this batch
the preparation Site was brought up to the DocType as committed, whose three counters were added after its previous migration

covers: the stored summary, result rows, counters and exact replay
an extracted worksheet admitted through the parsed entry, with a summary identical to the decoded-row entry for the same content
printed text lines and a framed table admitted through the same entry
a source with no revenue row, an unreadable source, an unknown source kind and a value over the stored precision refused before anything is stored
company scope and the recon feature, a revoked workspace permission, generic writes and shares, the immutable identity, pagination and deletion

checks.note: the new error keys are ASCII semantic keys, following the existing reconciliation.* convention

intentional_differences: the entry takes already-extracted content (worksheet cell rows, per-page text and tables, printed text lines, pipeline entries); opening the workbook or PDF, OCR and model calls stay in the legacy project, and the dispatch is by a named source kind instead of by file extension
decoded rows pass through the stored row contract, so a pipeline amount with more than six decimals (or an over-long text) is refused instead of stored as a binary float
a PDF whose table and text readers both keep no row is not retried through the OCR pipeline; it reports zero rows and the admission refuses it, leaving the fallback to the caller
the parse diagnostics are returned to the caller rather than stored, because the task DocType has no diagnostic field yet
the excel and table decoders also report a diag block the deployed excel decoder did not have, using the deployed PDF naming
not_run: reading a real Excel or PDF file (openpyxl and pdfplumber are outside this batch)
the output-VAT report parser family, file diagnostics and file names in storage, asynchronous jobs and polling, the review workbook export, batch delete
frontend integration, deployment, external business results and user acceptance
